entity.name: InfiniteZero Foundation
entity.description: Building an open, privacy-first AI commons on Ethereum: participants train shared AI models on their own devices, so raw data stays local. Founded in Computer Science at the University of Oxford; supported by Edge City's SHIFT Grants and the Cosmos Institute.

projects.name: InfiniteZero
projects.description: Open protocol for training AI as a public good (formerly the Decentralized Intelligence Network, DIN). Participants train models locally with federated learning and share model updates, not raw data, while smart contracts on Ethereum coordinate, verify and reward each training round. DevNet 1.0 is live on Optimism Sepolia, DevNet 2.0 is next, with a public testnet and a fair-launch mainnet planned.

channels.description: Contact for grants and institutional funding.
Crypto donations via Giveth (zero fees; donations are regularly matched).

plans.name: Protocol Sustainer
plans.description: Core funding for InfiniteZero protocol development, smart contracts, federated learning infrastructure, validator network scaling, and security audits. Priced at the FLOSS/fund annual ceiling.

plans.name: Goodwill contribution
plans.description: Any amount to support open AI infrastructure built for the public good.

history.description: Edge City SHIFT developer grant ($40,000, supported by Vitalik Buterin), awarded November 2025, for protocol development.
Cosmos Institute grant ($5,000), awarded by Brendan McCord, for early-stage research into decentralized intelligence networks.
University of Oxford support and compute ($5,000 equivalent) for research on decentralized AI and federated learning.
